prompt_md: Which of these improve chunking for retrieval? Select all that apply.

options.md: Split on headings and paragraphs instead of fixed character counts
options.why_md: Yes. Structure-aware boundaries keep ideas whole.

options.md: Prepend the document title and section heading to each chunk
options.why_md: Yes. Each chunk carries its context.

options.md: Embed each whole document as a single chunk
options.why_md: No. That causes truncation and dilution.

hints: Which idea applies? Chunks that are too big dilute meaning; chunks that are too small lose context.
Structure, overlap and contextual headers all help.
solution_md: Structure, overlap and contextual headers all help. Whole-document embedding hurts.
